name: Image Index
purpose: Fuse the image/document perception block (14-17) into one per-image record for a single image: image.util (#15) ALWAYS provides metadata + sha256/pHash/dHash (the deterministic backbone); ocr.layout (#14, -Ocr) adds text + word/line boxes + reading order; detect.objects (#16, -Detect) adds class boxes + real per-detection scores; image.interpret (#17, -Interpret) adds a local-VLM free-text interpretation. -All enables the three optional stages; -Capture sources the image once via capture.screen (#6). The capstone of the perception block (14-18): an orchestrator that spawns each child as pwsh, parses its result envelope, aggregates every child's model_provenance (stage-tagged), and redirects children's review-queue writes to an in-artifact child_review.jsonl -- it reimplements nothing and is NOT itself a review producer. Envelope confidence = the minimum confidence across the stochastic stages that ran (null when only image.util ran). Outputs a machine index.json and a human index.md card.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <image> (required unless -Capture); -Ocr/-Detect/-Interpret/-All (switches, enable the optional stages); -Capture (switch) + -CaptureInputsJson '<json>'; -MaxDimension <n> (passed to detect+interpret); -Language <code> (ocr); -Classes <c1,c2> (detect filter); -InterpretMode <caption|describe|vqa|screen> (def describe); -Prompt <q> (interpret vqa); -Tier <alias>/-InterpretModel <id> (interpret model); -ConfidenceThreshold <0..1> (def 0.5, passed to the stochastic children); path overrides -ImageUtilPath/-OcrPath/-DetectPath/-InterpretPath/-CapturePath; -PwshPath/-PythonPath/-Powershell51Path; -ReviewQueuePath <override>. OR -InputsJson '<json {input,ocr,detect,interpret,all,capture,capture_inputs,max_dimension,language,classes,interpret_mode,prompt,tier,interpret_model,confidence_threshold,...paths...,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the input image. Required unless capture is set.

inputs.name: capture
inputs.description: Source the image once from capture.screen (#6) instead of -InputFile; the captured PNG is fed to every stage.

inputs.name: ocr
inputs.description: Run ocr.layout (#14): text + per-word/line boxes + reading order.

inputs.name: detect
inputs.description: Run detect.objects (#16): class boxes + real per-detection scores + class summary.

inputs.name: interpret
inputs.description: Run image.interpret (#17): a local-VLM free-text interpretation.

inputs.name: max_dimension
inputs.description: Downscale bound passed to detect + interpret (they rescale boxes back to original); image.util meta/hash still run on the original.

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Passed to the stochastic children for their own review flagging (image.index does not itself flag).

outputs.description: { input{path,source,capture}, image{width,height,format,mode,has_alpha,dpi,metadata}, hashes{sha256,phash,dhash}, stages{ image_util, ocr, detect, interpret }(each {ran,status,confidence,reason,ms,artifact_dir,error,+payload}), summary{caption,ocr_text,ocr_word_count,top_objects[],detection_count,stochastic_confidence_min,stages_ran,stages_ok,stages_error}, review{mode,child_review_path,child_review_count,is_producer:false}, config{...} }. Envelope confidence = min stochastic child confidence (null if only image.util ran); model_provenance = stage-tagged aggregate of all children.

models: (none of its own; children transitively use ocr.windows.media, detect.yolox.nano, vlm.qwen2p5-vl-3b)
